items.title: Johnny Wiggs Interview, 1962-08-26
items.q: I went up to see Teddy Fongloo remember he played terror patch with us in the invincibles

ctx.x: well I'm writing down on the box here about your name Johnny Wiggs when did you change that name and oh you might get in there we only have another minute on

this reel Johnny Wiggs that that that was very recent that is say 17 years ago or something like that I was I'd been teaching school for 15 years and and I had quit teaching music and I felt sort of lost without music and I felt like going back to jazz I hadn't played jazz in maybe 20 years so I went up to see Teddy Fongloo remember he played terror patch with us in the invincibles he was at that time the 1945 he was the sales manager of WSMB so they had another band up there legitimate group of musicians and I…
So the poor legitimate man got the skids, and we went in. And what was the question you asked me now? Oh, yeah, why did I change my name?
